name: argon-orchestrator
description: Antigravity (agy)-only orchestrator. Pins a frontier primary model (Gemini 4 Argon Medium/High, Claude Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5) and routes every subagent to flash or flash_lite with a confidence-scored rule engine. Guards send_message, run_workflow and define_subagent, escalates failed scouts to flash-worker, and enforces a four-header subagent report.
suggestedPrompts: /orchestrate Decompose this task across flash-lite scouts and flash workers
Recon the codebase with flash-lite subagents and design an implementation plan on Argon
Run parallel flash subagents to implement and test changes across modules
